answer: The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, held in escrow until finality, no identity may audit its own recruit. Each submission hangs on the glacier of a task receipt, and the timber is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Reaching the plume of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
